items.title: Glorious Revolution
items.why: Vital article, level 5. The 1688 to 1689 overthrow of James II of England. Europe is the lane that trails least, but the vital-5 pool still offers it.

items.title: St. Bartholomew's Day massacre
items.why: Vital article, level 5. The 1572 massacre of Huguenots, part of the French Wars of Religion the atlas already holds.

items.title: First Barbary War
items.why: List of wars: 1500-1799. The 1801 to 1805 war between the United States and Tripoli. Africa trails every other lane.

items.title: Second Barbary War
items.why: List of wars: 1800-1899. The 1815 war between the United States and Algiers. Africa trails every other lane.

items.title: Hispano-Moroccan War (1859-60)
items.why: List of wars: 1800-1899. The 1859 to 1860 war between Spain and Morocco. Africa trails every other lane.

items.title: French occupation of Tunisia
items.why: The 1881 French conquest of Tunisia. Its own dates start before the Scramble for Africa's 1885, so it stands without a parent. Africa trails every other lane.

items.title: Franco-Moroccan War
items.why: List of wars: 1800-1899. The 1844 war between France and Morocco. Africa trails every other lane.

items.title: British Expedition to Abyssinia
items.why: The 1867 to 1868 British campaign against Emperor Tewodros II of Ethiopia. Africa trails every other lane.

items.title: Congo-Arab War
items.why: The 1892 war between the Congo Free State and Arab-Swahili traders. Its 1892 span sits inside the Scramble for Africa (1885 to 1914). Africa trails every other lane.

items.title: Second Madagascar expedition
items.why: The 1894 to 1895 French conquest of Madagascar. Its span sits inside the Scramble for Africa (1885 to 1914). Africa trails every other lane.

items.title: First Madagascar expedition
items.why: The 1883 to 1885 French campaign against Madagascar. It starts in 1883, before the Scramble for Africa's 1885, so it stands without a parent. Africa trails every other lane.

items.title: Turco-Egyptian conquest of Sudan (1820-1824)
items.why: Egypt's 1820 to 1824 conquest of Sudan under Muhammad Ali. Africa trails every other lane.

items.title: Ndwandwe-Zulu War
items.why: The 1817 to 1819 war between the Ndwandwe and the rising Zulu Kingdom. Africa trails every other lane.

items.title: Boshin War
items.why: Vital article, level 5 candidate by sitelink count. The 1868 to 1869 civil war that ended the Tokugawa shogunate. Asia trails after Africa.

items.title: First Anglo-Afghan War
items.why: List of wars: 1800-1899. The 1839 to 1842 war between Britain and Afghanistan. Asia trails after Africa.

items.title: Second Anglo-Afghan War
items.why: List of wars: 1800-1899. The 1878 to 1880 war between Britain and Afghanistan. Asia trails after Africa.

items.title: Battle of Sekigahara
items.why: The 1600 battle that decided control of Japan before the Tokugawa shogunate. Asia trails after Africa.

items.title: Shimabara Rebellion
items.why: The 1637 to 1638 rebellion of Japanese Christians and peasants against the Tokugawa shogunate. Asia trails after Africa.

items.title: Sino-French War
items.why: List of wars: 1800-1899. The 1884 to 1885 war between France and Qing China over Vietnam. Asia trails after Africa.

items.title: First Anglo-Sikh War
items.why: List of wars: 1800-1899. The 1845 to 1846 war between Britain and the Sikh Empire. Asia trails after Africa.

items.title: Siege of Osaka
items.why: The 1614 to 1615 siege that ended the Toyotomi clan and secured the Tokugawa shogunate. Asia trails after Africa.

items.title: First Anglo-Burmese War
items.why: List of wars: 1800-1899. The 1824 to 1826 war between Britain and the Konbaung dynasty of Burma. Asia trails after Africa.

items.title: First Anglo-Maratha War
items.why: List of wars: 1500-1799. The 1775 to 1782 war between the British East India Company and the Maratha Empire. Asia trails after Africa.

items.title: Japanese invasion of Taiwan (1874)
items.why: List of wars: 1800-1899. Japan's 1874 punitive expedition to Taiwan. Asia trails after Africa.

items.title: Java War
items.why: List of wars: 1800-1899. The 1825 to 1830 war between the Dutch and Prince Diponegoro in Java. Asia trails after Africa.

items.title: Treaty of Bassein (1534)
items.why: The 1534 treaty between the Sultanate of Gujarat and Portugal that ceded Bassein and Bombay. Asia trails after Africa.

items.title: War of 1812
items.why: Vital article, level 5 candidate by sitelink count. The 1812 to 1815 war between the United States and Britain.

items.title: Pastry War
items.why: The 1838 to 1839 French intervention in Mexico over unpaid debts.

items.title: Second French intervention in Mexico
items.why: List of wars: 1800-1899. France's 1861 to 1867 intervention in Mexico, which installed Maximilian I.

items.title: Reform War
items.why: Mexico's 1857 to 1861 civil war between liberals and conservatives.

items.title: Chincha Islands War
items.why: The 1864 to 1866 war between Spain and an alliance of Peru and Chile over the Chincha Islands.

items.title: Conquest of the Desert
items.why: Argentina's 1884 campaign against the indigenous peoples of Patagonia.

items.title: Paris Commune
items.why: Vital article, level 5 candidate by sitelink count. The 1871 Parisian government that followed the Franco-Prussian War. Its own dates start after that war's own end, so it stands without a parent.

items.title: Austro-Prussian War
items.why: The 1866 war between Prussia and Austria that settled supremacy over the German states.

items.title: Battle of Mohács
items.why: The 1526 battle in which the Ottomans defeated the Kingdom of Hungary.

items.title: Hundred Days
items.why: Napoleon's 1815 return from exile to his final defeat at Waterloo. Its span sits inside the Napoleonic Wars (1803 to 1815).

items.title: Nine Years' War
items.why: The 1688 to 1697 war between France and the Grand Alliance.

items.title: War of the First Coalition
items.why: The 1792 to 1797 war against Revolutionary France. Its span sits inside the French Revolutionary Wars (1792 to 1802).

items.title: Treaty of Alcáçovas
items.why: The 1479 treaty that ended the War of the Castilian Succession and divided Atlantic claims between Castile and Portugal, the model for the Treaty of Tordesillas.

items.title: Treaty of Zaragoza
items.why: The 1529 treaty that settled the Moluccas dispute between Castile and Portugal and fixed the antimeridian to the Treaty of Tordesillas' line.

items.title: War of the Castilian Succession
items.why: The 1475 to 1479 war between Castile and Portugal that the Treaty of Alcáçovas ended.

items.title: Revolutions of Tunis
items.why: Re-queued: the lane row for Q3458428 was added to the seeds file on 14 October, so the item the writer refused for a missing lane now enters. The 1675 to 1705 uprisings against Ottoman Tunis. Africa trails every other lane.

items.title: Cherokee-American wars
items.why: Re-queued: the lane row for Q4122685 was added to the seeds file on 14 October, so the item the writer refused for a missing lane now enters. The 1776 to 1794 wars between the Cherokee and American settlers. Its span sits inside the American Indian Wars (1609 to 1924).
